method.bigram_variants: bigram_with_shipped_dictionary keeps the production head set and dictionary unchanged; candidate_only also reranks heads against a merged dictionary; shipped_plus appends without reranking shipped successors
method.confidence_intervals: paired normal approximation on per-event hit differences; 95%; identical denominators
method.dictionary_merge_bound: lower: words absent from the shipped asset receive only their candidate frequency; no Leipzig tail credit
method.normalization: NFC; existing dictionary/bigram token rules; line collisions use NFC + casefold + whitespace collapse
method.register_caveat: Register fields are surface proxies, not human judgments of naturalness or domain labels.
method.size_measurement: Production dictionary schema and TATBIGR schema-3 packers, in memory only; no bundled asset or pin is written.
method.training_exclusion: All normalized sentences in the Common Voice test, TatSC test, and current native held-out domains are removed from every candidate's training input.
